game_concept: A puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate, a weathered stone gate: the ruin warden must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Queue Line: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate: a weathered stone gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Weathered Gate, repeat each round: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the queue_calm value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the relic vault using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The relic vault reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the relic vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Queue Line
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Queue Line' (Week 7 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Weathered Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_calm changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Weathered Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The relic vault reached with actions_used <= 17.
